svg.title: Alberta auto insurance shopping timeline through Care-First
svg.desc: Private-market quotes continue. Collisions before 1 January 2027 stay on the court-based system. Collisions on or after that date are handled under Care-First. The grid rating system is repealed the same day, with no replacement announced.
svg.text: Shop now. The accident date picks the system.
Alberta.ca Care-First and reform pages, and the 21 Sep 2026 basics PDF. Re-read at renewal.
Care-First. Earlier injury claims stay on the court-based system.
A cap limits an increase. It does not shop the premium for you.
AIRB average rate-change ceiling in 2026: 12.5%. From 2027, average rates 5% and a 10% cap for an average driver at renewal.
A new at-fault claim, a conviction, a driver, a vehicle, or a coverage change can remove the 2027 protection.
Current common-injury care is described as 10 to 21 pre-approved visits. Care-First drops that visit cap for eligible care.
Quote at least two markets at the same liability and the same collision deductible. Physical damage is still insurer-priced.
